name: cynicism
quote: I don't think he's doing that just to be nice.
description: A sense that someone is acting from hidden selfish intentions.
perceptions: That person's stated intentions are one thing.
I think their real unspoken intentions are more selfish than what they're showing.

guidance.description: 5 Ways to Overcome Cynicism and Stay Hopeful About Humanity

comparisons.description: Cynicism is a tentative prediction that someone is cheating, or not being fully honest.

variations.name: cynical outlook
variations.description: A pattern of belief that people generally act out of selfish intentions.
perceptions: Everyone's real unspoken intentions are more selfish than what they show.

commentaries.quote: Cynicism masquerades as wisdom, but it is the farthest thing from it. Because cynics don't learn anything. Because cynicism is a self-imposed blindness, a rejection of the world because we are afraid it will hurt us or disappoint us.

A cynical habit of thought and speech, a readiness to criticize work which the critic himself never tries to perform, an intellectual aloofness which will not accept contact with life’s realities — all these are marks, not as the possessor would fain to think, of superiority but of weakness.
The power of accurate observation is commonly called cynicism by those who have not got it.
